# Local TOTP

A local-first static website that computes RFC 6238 TOTP codes in the browser with Web Crypto HMAC.

## Privacy
- Secrets never leave the device / never go to a server.
- localStorage keys: totpPreferredLanguage (language) and totpLocalVault (optional local history).
- Prefer #secret= URL fragments; query and path forms are supported then rewritten.

## Crypto
- Base32 alphabet A-Z2-7, spaces/hyphens/padding stripped.
- HMAC-SHA1 / SHA-256 / SHA-512 via crypto.subtle.
- Test vectors: /rfc6238-test-vectors.json (RFC 6238 Appendix B).

## Tools and guides
See /site-map and /sitemap.xml. This is not an official ChatGPT, Google, or Microsoft authenticator.
